name: Deploy
text: Trigger this ability when played.

name: Initiative
text: Trigger this ability if you haven't used an Order, Fee or Spring ability this turn.

name: Order
text: An ability triggered manually by the player. Cards with Order cannot be used for 1 turn after being placed on the battlefield.

name: Melee
text: This ability can only be used while on the melee row.

name: Drain
text: Damage ignoring the target's armor, then boost self by the damage dealt.

name: Ranged
text: This ability can only be used while on the ranged row.

name: Reveal
text: Show a card to both players, then hide it back in the hand or deck.

name: Lineage
text: At the start of the game, boost self by the number of Dragons in your starting deck.

name: Timer
text: Before the end of your turn, lower the number by 1. When the number reaches 0, trigger the ability.

name: Spawn
text: Add a card to the game.

name: Zeal
text: An Order ability can be used on the same turn the card is placed on the battlefield.

name: Cooldown
text: The number of turns before an Order or Fee ability can be reused.

name: Adrenaline
text: Trigger this ability if you have specified number or fewer cards in your hand. Cards with Adrenaline are highlighted when their effect is stronger.

name: Summon
text: Move automatically to the battlefield (not considered played).

name: Charge
text: The number of times an Order ability can be used. Only cards with Charge: X can gain additional Charges.

name: Cataclysm
text: At the start of the owner's turn, split 3 damage randomly between units in this row.

name: Heal
text: If a unit's current power is lower than its base power, restore it either to base power or by the amount specified.

name: Banish
text: Remove from the game. Note: Does not count as being destroyed.

name: Doomed
text: Status that removes the card from the game after it leaves the battlefield.

name: Storm
text: At the start of the owner's turn, damage all units on this row by 1.

name: Veil
text: Status that prevents unit from gaining other statuses.

name: Frost
text: At the start of the owner's turn, damage the highest power unit in this row by 2.

name: Fog
text: At the start of the owner's turn, damage the lowest power unit in this row by 2.

name: Rain
text: At the start of the owner's turn, damage 2 random units in this row by 1.

name: Bloodthirst
text: Number of damaged enemy units required to trigger this ability.

name: Lock
text: Status that disables a unit's abilities.

name: Formation
text: If played on the melee row, gain Zeal. If played on the ranged row, boost self by 1.

name: Inspired
text: Trigger this ability if this unit's current power is higher than its base power.

name: Bleeding
text: Status that damages the unit by 1 at the end of its turn. Note: Bleeding turns can accumulate, 1 turn of Bleeding cancels out 1 turn of Vitality. Bleeding ignores armor.

name: Disloyal
text: This card is played on the opposite side of the battlefield, then gains Spying.

name: Coin
text: The Novigradian underworld's currency of choice for paying Fees and Tributes. You may possess a maximum of 9 Coins. Your Coin-count is reduced by half (rounded down) when carried over into the next round.

name: Patience
text: At the end of your turn, if Order is not used, increase the card's specified value by 1 for the rest of the game.

name: Deathwish
text: Trigger this ability when destroyed and moved from the battlefield to the graveyard. Note: Banished units are not sent to the graveyard.

name: Armor
text: Protects the unit from damage. This value doesn't count towards your score and/or the unit's power.

name: Crew
text: Trigger this ability if this unit is between two Soldiers.

name: Resupply
text: Whenever you play a Warfare card, reduce this card's Cooldown by 1.

name: Vitality
text: Status that boosts this unit by 1 on its turn end. Note: Vitality turns can accumulate; 1 turn of Vitality cancels out 1 turn of Bleeding.

name: Barricade
text: Trigger this ability if the unit has armor.

name: Exposed
text: Trigger this ability whenever the unit loses its Armor.

name: Grace
text: The first time this unit's power is equal to or higher than the specified amount, trigger the ability. If the condition is already met when it enters the battlefield, trigger it immediately.

name: Shield
text: Status that blocks the next instance of damage dealt to a unit.

name: Devotion
text: Trigger this ability if your starting deck has no neutral cards.

name: Purify
text: Remove all statuses.

name: Immunity
text: Status whereby this card cannot be manually targeted.

name: Consume
text: Destroy a unit and boost self by its power. If target is in the graveyard, Banish it instead.

name: Seize
text: Move an enemy unit to the opposite row and give it Spying. If it already had Spying, remove Spying instead.

name: Thrive
text: Boost this unit by 1 or the specified amount whenever you play a unit with higher power.

name: Infused
text: Status that adds effects or categories to a card. Removing the status also removes all added effects and categories. Lock disables Infused abilities.

name: Dominance
text: Trigger this ability if you control the highest unit on the battlefield.

name: Bonded
text: Trigger this ability if you control a copy of this card.

name: Resilience
text: Status that allows a unit to remain on the battlefield at the end of the round, then disappears.\nNote: Boost and Armor are not carried over to the next round.

name: Deathblow
text: Trigger this ability if this card destroys a unit.

name: Ambush
text: Played face down, then flips over when the ability's condition is met.

name: Spring
text: Manual activation of a face-down Trap. Spring is activated automatically on a Trap played next to an Artifact. Cards with Spring are flipped over after use.

name: Discard
text: Move a card from your hand to the graveyard. Note: Related abilities are not triggered when discarding manually.

name: Veteran
text: At the start of the second and third round, increase the base power of this unit by 1.

name: Berserk
text: Trigger this ability whenever power is equal to or lower than the specified amount.

name: Echo
text: At the beginning of the round, move this card from the graveyard to the top of its owner's deck. Give it Doomed.

name: Conspiracy
text: Trigger this ability if target unit has Spying status.

name: Flanking
text: If this unit is adjacent to only one card: on your Melee row, its end of turn ability is triggered twice; on your Ranged row, gain 1 Armor at the end of your turn.

name: Create
text: Spawn one of three randomly selected cards from the specified source.

name: Poison
text: Status - if a unit receives two instances of Poison, destroy it.

name: Predator
text: This ability can only target units with power lower than own.

name: Symbiosis
text: Whenever you play a Nature card, Spawn a Wandering Treant on a random allied row and set its power equal to number of Symbioses you control.

name: Might
text: Trigger this ability if you control a unit with 10 or more power on each of your rows.

name: Duel
text: Units take turns dealing damage equal to their power until one of them is destroyed.

name: Harmony
text: Boost self by 1 or the specified amount whenever you play a non-Neutral unit, whose primary category is unique among all of your units.

name: Dragon's Dream
text: At the start of the owner's turn, when timer expires, damage all units in this row by 3.

name: Blood Moon
text: At the start of the owner's turn, give a random unit in this row Bleeding (2). If the unit is already Bleeding, damage it by 2 instead.

name: Assimilate
text: Boost self by 1 or the specified amount whenever you play a card that is not from your starting deck.

name: Tribute
text: On Deploy, you may choose to spend the specified amount of Coins to trigger this ability.

name: Profit
text: Gain a specified number of Coins when this card is played. You may possess a maximum of 9 Coins.

name: Fee
text: Trigger this ability by spending the specified number of Coins.

name: Bounty
text: When a unit with this status is destroyed or banished, opponent gains coins equal to its base power. There can be only one unit with Bounty status on each side of the board at given time.

name: Intimidate
text: Boost self by 1 or the specified amount whenever you play a Crime card.

name: Insanity
text: If you have insufficient Coins, damage this unit by its Fee amount, ignoring its Armor, to trigger its Fee ability.\nNote: Insanity cannot be used if it would destroy the unit and works only if damage is inflicted.

name: Hoard
text: Trigger this ability if you possess the specified number of Coins or more.

name: Defender
text: Status that prevents the opponent from targeting other cards in this row.

name: Rupture
text: At the end of owner's turn, damage this unit equal to its base power, then remove this status.

name: Clash
text: Units simultanously damage each other by their power.

name: Sabbath
text: Trigger this ability if at least one of your rows has a total of 25 or more points.

name: Vice
text: Trigger this ability after you spent the specified amount of Coins, then reset own counter.

name: Counter
text: Reduce the Counter whenever the given condition is met. Reset the Counter when the Unit leaves the Board. (2020 definition)

name: Reset
text: Restore a unit to its base power. (2020 definition)

name: Spying
text: Spying units are played on the opponent's side of the board but benefit their owner.
